patch.role: First cooperation leg: decides whether the local repair applies (italic and no colour).
Second cooperation leg: consumes the U1 flag and prepends the missing closing italic tag.

inputs.mask_italic: italic-only token style, default formatter mode
inputs.expose_italic_color: italic + colour token style (U1 is false, so U2 cannot run)
inputs.control_bold: bold-only style; A is not executed
inputs.mask_italic_codetag: italic-only style, codetag mode; A executes and the same repair pair masks it

rationale: A prepends the closing italic tag.  Neither U1 (a flag) nor U2 (the tag insertion) alone restores the P+ output on mask_italic; only their cooperation does.  The pair is declared for tokens without colour, so expose_italic_color is the legal exposing witness.
